# Purpose

This validates the dynamic-tree precision snapshots exported by `GenerationTimeGibbsOperatorTest`.

Activate snapshot export in `02_generate_xml.Rmd` with at least one of:

```r
export_dynamic_snapshots <- TRUE
validate_dynamic_precision <- TRUE
validate_dynamic_conditional <- TRUE
prepare_frozen_tree_validation <- TRUE
```


```{r helpers}
library(Matrix)
library(ape)

if (!file.exists(sim_data_path)) {
  stop("Simulation data not found. Run 01_simulate_data.Rmd first: ", sim_data_path)
}

sim_data <- readRDS(sim_data_path)
y <- sim_data$y

list_snapshot_ids <- function(beast_output_dir, prefix_regex = "snapshot") {
  state_files <- list.files(
    beast_output_dir,
    pattern = "_state[.]csv$",
    full.names = FALSE
  )

  ids <- sub("_state[.]csv$", "", state_files)
  ids[grepl(prefix_regex, ids)]
}

read_snapshot <- function(snapshot_id, beast_output_dir) {
  snapshot_prefix <- file.path(beast_output_dir, snapshot_id)

  list(
    tree_edges = read.csv(
      paste0(snapshot_prefix, "_tree_edges.csv"),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
      check.names = FALSE,
      na.strings = ""
    ),
    precision = read.csv(
      paste0(snapshot_prefix, "_precision_triplets.csv"),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
      check.names = FALSE,
      na.strings = ""
    ),
    state = read.csv(
      paste0(snapshot_prefix, "_state.csv"),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
      check.names = FALSE,
      na.strings = ""
    )
  )
}

truthy <- function(x) {
  tolower(as.character(x)) == "true"
}
```


# Precision validation function

```{r precision-validation-function}
validate_snapshot_precision <- function(snapshot_id, beast_output_dir) {

  snapshot <- read_snapshot(snapshot_id, beast_output_dir)

  tree_edges_snapshot <- snapshot$tree_edges
  precision_snapshot <- snapshot$precision
  state_snapshot <- snapshot$state

  n_nodes <- nrow(tree_edges_snapshot)

  Q_beast <- Matrix::sparseMatrix(
    i = precision_snapshot$row_node_nr + 1,
    j = precision_snapshot$col_node_nr + 1,
    x = precision_snapshot$value,
    dims = c(n_nodes, n_nodes)
  )

  is_root <- truthy(tree_edges_snapshot$is_root)
  non_root_edges <- tree_edges_snapshot[!is_root, ]

  rows <- integer(0)
  cols <- integer(0)
  vals <- numeric(0)

  for (e in seq_len(nrow(non_root_edges))) {

    child <- non_root_edges$node_nr[e] + 1
    parent <- non_root_edges$parent_nr[e] + 1
    branch_length <- non_root_edges$length[e]

    if (branch_length <= 0) {
      stop("Non-positive branch length in snapshot ", snapshot_id)
    }

    w <- 1 / branch_length

    rows <- c(rows, child, parent, child, parent)
    cols <- c(cols, child, parent, parent, child)
    vals <- c(vals, w, w, -w, -w)
  }

  Q_rebuilt <- Matrix::sparseMatrix(
    i = rows,
    j = cols,
    x = vals,
    dims = c(n_nodes, n_nodes)
  )

  difference <- Q_rebuilt - Q_beast

  root_node_nr <- unique(state_snapshot$root_node_nr)
  stopifnot(length(root_node_nr) == 1)

  generation_times <- state_snapshot$generation_time[
    order(state_snapshot$node_nr)
  ]

  q_beast <- as.numeric(
    t(generation_times) %*% Q_beast %*% generation_times
  )

  q_rebuilt <- as.numeric(
    t(generation_times) %*% Q_rebuilt %*% generation_times
  )

  data.frame(
    snapshot_id = snapshot_id,
    n_nodes = n_nodes,
    quadratic_form_beast = q_beast,
    quadratic_form_rebuilt = q_rebuilt,
    quad_form_abs_difference = abs(q_beast - q_rebuilt),
    beast_nonzeros = length(Q_beast@x),
    rebuilt_nonzeros = length(Q_rebuilt@x),
    same_sparse_pattern = identical(summary(Q_beast)[, 1:2], summary(Q_rebuilt)[, 1:2]),
    max_abs_difference_Q = max(c(0, abs(difference@x))),
    root_is_coupled_in_full_Q = sum(Q_beast[root_node_nr + 1, ] != 0) > 0
  )
}
```

# Run validation

```{r run-validation}
snapshot_ids <- list_snapshot_ids(beast_output_dir)

if (length(snapshot_ids) == 0) {
  stop("No snapshot files found in ", beast_output_dir)
}

snapshot_validation_results <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(snapshot_ids, validate_snapshot_precision, beast_output_dir = beast_output_dir)
)

snapshot_validation_summary <- data.frame(
  n_snapshots = nrow(snapshot_validation_results),
  all_sparse_patterns_pass = all(snapshot_validation_results$same_sparse_pattern),
  all_root_coupled_in_full_Q = all(snapshot_validation_results$root_is_coupled_in_full_Q),
  max_abs_difference_Q = max(snapshot_validation_results$max_abs_difference_Q),
  max_quad_form_abs_difference = max(snapshot_validation_results$quad_form_abs_difference)
)

snapshot_validation_results
snapshot_validation_summary
```
Interpretation:

This validation checks whether the precision matrix rebuilt independently in R from exported BEAST tree edges matches the sparse Brownian precision matrix exported directly by BEAST.

- `same_sparse_pattern` checks whether both matrices contain nonzero entries in exactly the same locations.
- `max_abs_difference_Q` measures the largest absolute entry-wise difference between the matrices.
- `quad_form_abs_difference` compares quadratic forms [u^T Q u] computed using the BEAST-exported and independently rebuilt precision matrices.
- `root_is_coupled_in_full_Q` verifies that the root coupling structure is preserved correctly.
